Pre-existing S1 legacy path: ExecuteScheduledStepActivity passes resp.Output into StepResult.Output, which flows into Temporal history; the plan forbids content in Temporal history.

The contract's max_tokens_per_round is now enforced per round, but the round count and token budget are not bounded by a run-level token cap; a long tool loop can still spend up to 8 rounds at 4096 tokens each.

A non-completed agent-lane step still calls CompleteRunActivity after the failed summary; the run is terminalized as completed by the orchestrator's activity flow unless session-core maps the failed receipt, which needs checking live.

results.notes: Round 2 fixes applied. (1) agent.rs finalize takes an append_answer bool that the scheduled lane passes as false, so the transcript written through RecordScheduledRunResult is the only assistant message the thread gets. (2) A new Option<LoopScope> parameter threads through run_agent_with_offered and run_agent_with_route_parkable (None for every other caller, including tests). It sets LoopContext.max_tokens from contract.max_tokens_per_round (the inference request uses ctx.max_tokens instead of MAX_TOKENS), and it skips result_query (result_store is None when scoped). (3) scheduled_agent::wall_clock(contract, now) returns min(240 s, time left on the contract), zero if the expiry does not parse; grpc.rs uses it for the timeout. (4) scheduled_agent::refuses_retention(zdr, waived) returns REFUSAL_RETENTION (scheduled_zdr_refused); grpc.rs calls it first, before admit, and finishes the step as failed. The caller it checks is the lane's own AuthenticatedUser, which has zdr false and no waiver until ScheduledStepContext carries the run's retention and waiver, so the refusal is inert until the lead's fields land. (5) scheduledAgentOutcomeSummary reports failed when the last step is not Completed, takes precedence over needs_review, and has a Go test with Completed false. Status stays partial for the items in lead_todo: session-core contract serving, the lib.rs module move, the ZDR/waiver fields, the flag in compose, and the zdr-posture row.
